title: Shopping leaflet or printed price list
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 1: Percentages; area, perimeter and volume; statistics; shape
source: Seeded from mathematics/y6 lesson 58 (Shopping leaflet or printed price list)
intro: Lesson 58: Percentage problems: discounts and zakah. To understand how to solve real-life percentage problems, including discounts and zakah

questions.q: Find the sale price of each item.
questions.a: Coat £102; shoes £36; prayer mat £32.40; bag £60; bike £175

questions.q: How much do you save on the bike?
Sale prices: £80 with 25% off; £36 with 10% off; £250 with 30% off
A family's savings of £6,400 have been kept a full lunar year above the nisab. Zakah at 2.5%?
Big question: how much zakah is due?
questions.a: Usually 2.5% (one fortieth) of savings above the nisab kept for a lunar year
